# ClearForge

> ClearForge (Clearforge AI LLC) is an AI consulting and build firm for mid-market companies with $20 million to $500 million in revenue, and for the private equity firms that own them. We find the jobs in a company that AI can do, build the AI to do them, and stay until the people use it. Work starts with a two-week review at one fixed price. The practice background is Bain's AI and Automation practice, with earlier work at EY and Capgemini.

## What ClearForge does, in four steps

1. Find it (2 weeks, one fixed price): commercial and performance diligence that finds where AI adds the most earnings, a business case per opportunity ranked by worth, cost and payback, and a priced plan for the one workflow worth building first. If nothing is worth building, we say so, and the client keeps the findings. A full business valuation is available on request.
2. Build it (10 to 14 weeks): forward-deployed engineers build the system with the people who will use it, in the email and software they already work in. A person approves anything that reaches a customer.
3. Get the team using it (first 90 days): one person from ClearForge meets the team every week. The goal is 7 in 10 intended users active every week by day 90.
4. Keep it running (monthly): daily checks on what each system produced, step-by-step run tracing, model updates, and a monthly report of use, quality, results and running cost against the business case.

Catalog names: Forge Diagnostic (step 1), Forge Sprint (step 2), Forge Scale (step 3, with a Fractional Chief AI Officer tier), Forge Run (step 4), and the Eval and Reliability Audit for AI systems a company already built. Fees: each step is priced before it starts; no prices are published.

## For private equity

- AI value creation across a portfolio: one diagnostic model run across the companies the sponsor chooses, so results compare.
- AI reaches EBITDA through three levers: more revenue from the same team, lower cost to serve, and less cash tied up in the work. Each business case is stated in earnings from the company's own records, so it can go into the value creation plan.
- AI value diligence on a target before close, so the AI case is in the value creation plan from day one.
- Results reported to the operating team in one format per company: use, quality, results and running cost.
- Offer name: PE Portfolio Pack (portfolio AI scan, diagnostic multipack, sponsor scoreboard), scoped with the sponsor.

## Results (anonymized client records)

- A $4B industrial conglomerate: an AI system that reads news of new plants, expansions and building projects, picks the ones that need the company's products, and writes each salesperson a one-page brief. Leads that fit what the company sells rose from 19 a month to 613 a month by month six; 1,181 across three divisions in six months.
- A home and commercial services firm: 42 businesses found, 31 contacted, 18 quoted, 7 recurring accounts won.

## Ownership and data

- The client owns its data and everything the system produces for it (leads, reports, briefs). ClearForge owns the software that produces them, and runs and updates it. If the client stops, it keeps everything the system made.
- Data stays in the client's systems wherever possible. Model providers run under API terms that exclude client data from training.
